entities.name: Viktor Ferdinand Brotherus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Viktor Ferdinand Brotherus was a Finnish botanist who studied the mosses (Bryophyta). He is best known for authoring the treatment of 'Musci' in Engler and Prantl's Die Naturlichen Pflanzenfamilien.
